svg.title: Жим штанги из-за головы сидя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. SEATED BEHIND-THE-NECK BARBELL PRESS, REAR three-quarter view so bar path behind head is visible. Both figures sit on weight bench with horizontal seat and backrest and feet on floor. Hands grasp ONE long barbell WIDE with weight plates at both ends. Left barbell is behind head at upper-trapezius/ear height, elbows bent under hands. Right barbell pressed straight overhead, elbows nearly extended. Show head IN FRONT of barbell in starting position and bench supporting hips. Not a front press. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
